itens.titulo: Ark Invest Sells $15 Million Of Its Own Bitcoin ETF As Price Falls
itens.descricao: Ark Invest Sells $15 Million Of Its Own Bitcoin ETF As Price Falls Yahoo Finance
trechos: Asset manager Ark Invest has sold $15.9 million U.S.
worth of its own Bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC) exchange-traded fund (ETF) as the price of the largest cryptocurrency declines.
The firm led by investor Cathie Wood offloaded its ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (NYSE: $ARKB) from its investment funds as the price of the crypto declines from its early October highs.
To ensure diversification, Ark does not let any individual holding take up more than 10% of its fund portfolios.
The fund currently has $2.5 billion U.S.
Ark Invest's sale comes as the price of Bitcoin falls below the key support level of $80,000 U.S.
27, BTC was trading at $79,700 U.S.
So far in October, Bitcoin's price has declined 6%, dropping from a high of $86,000 U.S.

itens.titulo: Coca-Cola raises full-year outlook after profit rise in Q3
itens.descricao: Coca-Cola raises full-year outlook after profit rise in Q3 Yahoo Finance
trechos: For fiscal 2026, the company now expects organic revenue growth of at least 5%, compared with its previous forecast of approximately 5%.
Comparable currency-neutral earnings per share, excluding acquisitions and divestitures, are now expected to increase at least 9%, up from the earlier range of 7% to 8%.
"Our results this quarter demonstrate our system's sustained momentum, giving us confidence in our updated full year guidance," said Henrique Braun, chief executive of The Coca-Cola Company.
Third-quarter net income rose to $4.009 billion from $3.696 billion a year earlier.
Excluding items, adjusted earnings came in at $3.944 billion.
Operating income increased 12% to $4.465 billion from $3.982 billion last year.
The company's revenue for the period rose 7.4% to $13.380 billion from $12.456 billion in the prior year.
Organic revenue increased 7%, supported by 7% growth in concentrate sales and a 1% rise in price/mix.

itens.titulo: Coca-Cola raises 2026 earnings guidance after quarterly revenue grows
itens.descricao: Coca-Cola raises 2026 earnings guidance after quarterly revenue grows Yahoo Finance
trechos: The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) raised its full-year earnings guidance after third-quarter revenue increased 7% to $13.4 billion and comparable earnings per share rose 11% to $0.91.
The Atlanta-based company now expects comparable earnings per share to grow by at least 11% in 2026, up from its previous forecast of 9% to 10%.
Coca-Cola also raised its free cash flow forecast to at least $13 billion, up from approximately $12.4 billion, while projecting cash generated from operations of at least $15.2 billion.
Organic revenue growth, which excludes the effects of currency movements and acquisitions and disposals, is expected to reach at least 5%, compared with previous guidance of approximately 5%.
Third-quarter operating performance benefited from stronger beverage volumes, with global unit case sales increasing 5% as Coca-Cola gained customers in India, China, Mexico and Brazil.
Comparable operating income, which excludes certain exceptional items, rose 8% after accounting for currency movements, while the comparable operating margin expanded to 32.9% from 31.9%.
The drink group's reported operating income increased 12% to $4.5 billion, while reported earnings per share rose 8% to $0.93.
Concentrate sales increased by 7%, and pricing along with product mix contributed an additional 1% to revenue growth, which partly offset the impact of an unfavourable sales mix.

itens.titulo: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
itens.descricao: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership CNBC
trechos: Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices have said they will invest a total of $4 billion in Meta after the social media and artificial intelligence giant announced plans to raise $95 billion to support its investments in AI infrastructure.
Meta on Monday said it would initially raise $35 billion in underwritten public equity offerings, before raising an additional $60 billion with an at-the-market program.
Nvidia on Tuesday said it would invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering, with AMD announcing it would invest $1 billion.
Meta's Monday announcement said Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom were interested in purchasing up to $5 billion in shares.
"AI agents represent a new computing paradigm — software that understands our goals, reasons, uses tools and gets work done on our behalf," said Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in a statement.

"This changes how we use computers, from operating applications to working with intelligent agents." "We're excited to keep working with NVIDIA to deliver the best personal agents and frontier models for billions of people," said Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

"Together, we are building and deploying infrastructure at gigawatt scale and shaping future generations of silicon, software and systems to enable Meta's most ambitious superintelligence models and services," AMD CEO Lisa Su said in a statement.
AMD was up 3% on Tuesday, while Nvidia stayed flat.

itens.titulo: BBAS3: ação do Banco do Brasil sobe após “tombo” de quase 30%; mercado mantém cautela
itens.descricao: BBAS3: ação do Banco do Brasil sobe após “tombo” de quase 30%; mercado mantém cautela InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade As ações do Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) registram ganhos nesta terça-feira (27), em recuperação parcial após o tombo de quase 30% da véspera.
Às 11h11 (horário de Brasília), BBAS3 subiam 2,06%, a R$ 17,83, mas chegaram a subir mais de 3% mais cedo.
Na véspera, as ações BBAS3 desabaram 29,33%, fechando na mínima desde maio de 2023, a R$17,47, em sessão bastante negativa para o setor financeiro.
Apesar da recuperação das ações nesta terça-feira, analistas de mercado seguem reticentes com a tese sobre BBAS3.
De acordo com compilação da Reuters com casas de análise, 6 delas recomendam manutenção das ações, 3 recomendam venda e só 2 recomendam compra.
O preço-alvo para as ações do Banco do Brasil foi reduzido de R$ 22,40 para R$ 15.
Leia mais: Os analistas também ficam de olho nos resultados do banco estatal, a serem divulgados dia 11 de novembro, sendo a instituição financeira vista com maior cautela durante a temporada.
Continua depois da publicidade O Bradesco BBI projeta lucro líquido de R$ 1,8 bilhão, mais de 50% inferior ao registrado no trimestre anterior e bem abaixo das expectativas do mercado.

itens.titulo: Tesouro Direto atrasa abertura mais uma vez, em meio a expectativa de queda nas taxas
itens.descricao: Tesouro Direto atrasa abertura mais uma vez, em meio a expectativa de queda nas taxas InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade O Tesouro Direto ainda não liberou as negociações nesta terça-feira (27), em meio à forte volatilidade do mercado, mas a expectativa é de taxas em queda.

Os juros futuros operam em queda nesta manhã, depois da disparada de segunda-feira (26), primeiro pregão após a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), e o Tesouro Nacional voltou a intervir no mercado.
Por volta das 9h10, os contratos de juros futuros de prazo mais longo recuavam cerca de 8 pontos-base, depois de subirem mais de 200 pontos-base na véspera.
O dólar também cedia e chegou a cair 1,52%, a R$ 5,320, depois de fechar a segunda em alta de 8,25%, a R$ 5,403.
Às 9h22, o Tesouro cancelou o leilão de LFT, atreladas à Selic, previsto para esta terça.
O órgão também anunciou uma nova recompra de NTN-B, títulos atrelados à inflação, com vencimentos em 2030, 2035, 2040 e 2045.
Na segunda, o Tesouro recomprou 8,4 milhões de NTN-F, papéis prefixados, em operação de cerca de R$ 7,1 bilhões.
À tarde, comprou de volta cerca de 1,76 milhão de NTN-B, em volume superior a R$ 7 bilhões.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa opera na estabilidade após tombo com eleição; dólar cai mais de 1%
itens.descricao: Ibovespa opera na estabilidade após tombo com eleição; dólar cai mais de 1% Exame
trechos: O Ibovespa iniciou as negociações nesta terça-feira, 27, em alta, mas não sustentou o movimento e oscila entre leves perdas após a queda de 13,88% registrada na véspera, quando o mercado reagiu à reeleição de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
Por volta das 10h32 (horário de Brasília), o principal índice da B3 avançava 0,44%, aos 177.377 pontos, mas, às 11h20, já recuava 0,27%, aos 176.132,55 pontos.
O dólar comercial caía 1,39%, a R$ 5,328.
Na véspera, a moeda americana disparou 8,21%, para R$ 5,4027, na maior valorização diária desde 1999.
A sessão de segunda-feira, 26, também foi marcada pelo acionamento do "circuit breaker" da B3 logo na abertura.
O Ibovespa terminou o dia em queda de 13,88%, aos 176.608 pontos, maior perda desde 2020.
Entre as ações de maior peso, Vale (VALE3) perde 1,72% e Petrobras (PETR4) recua 1,71%, enquanto os bancos recuperam parte das perdas da véspera.
Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) sobe 3,84%, Itaú (ITUB4) avança 1,53% e Bradesco ganha 0,94% nas ações preferenciais (BBDC4) e 1,40% nas ordinárias (BBDC3).
